title: May not be space saving & weight of clothes may break rod; assembly required
text:
May not be space saving & weight of clothes may break rod; assembly required. There are six colorful "space-saving" hangers in this package. Each one requires a slight assembly of the hook onto the hanging structure. Once installed, the hook can be slid around the hanger to either sit horizontally like a regular hanger or vertically.

For me, these are not space saving at all. Instead it drops the level of the clothing down to my next rod level, interfering with the bottom of my closet. In addition, there is now a bulk of clothes that hangs down a little further away from the closet rod. Even if it were space saving, the weight of the extra clothes may bring down the rod. There are nine holes on the hanger, which means there is room for nine garments, so each hanger gets very heavy.

Therefore, I would consider these more like closet organizers that do not save space but enable one to hang the clothes neater in the closet. After having tried these, I know they do not work for me.

The current price of $16.99 brings this to $2.83 per plastic hanger.
